project.name: 智教星首页重设计

intentProfile.routingReason: User rejected v1 (symmetric left-right) and v2 (42/58 split) as AI-looking. v3 applies Linear/Cursor/Vercel-style centered full-bleed product-theater layout — NO left-right splits anywhere. Redesign comparison, source project not mutated.

lowValueCallWatchdog.noProgressNextAction: dispatch v3 page build then validate

project.designRead: Linear.app / Cursor.sh / Vercel.com centered full-bleed product-theater patterns → NO left-right splits, product UI as hero, vertical scroll narrative
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Dark Product Theater (深色产品剧场): warm near-black #0B0B0D base, warm paper #EDEAE3 text, single warm-amber #E8B547 accent on data/key numbers only. Inter (display, heavy 800-900, tight tracking) + Fraunces/Noto Serif SC (editorial section numbers, pull-quotes) + JetBrains Mono (eyebrows, data, terminal). CENTERED full-bleed hero with product console bleeding to viewport edges below headline (Linear/Cursor pattern). NO left-right splits anywhere. Editorial numbering 01-05. Full-width sections with varying heights. Product UI mockups built in HTML/CSS. Bento grid deliberately unequal. Terminal tech stack. Full-width pull quotes. No 50/50 splits, no equal card grids, no alternating left-right features, no purple-blue gradients, no FAQ accordion.
project.styleContinuityAnchors: none — v3 is a fresh visual language; v1 (editorial light) and v2 (dark split) preserved as comparison baselines

cssPreflightEvidence.notes: Head generated via apply-html-head-contract.mjs from colors_and_type-v3.css (dark theme). All contract requirements met.

errorSignatures.normalized: [html-infrastructure] [MAIN-AGENT] index-v2.html missing Tailwind CSS CDN (<script src="...@tailwindcss/browser@4">). Impact: all utility classes stop working; page degrades to unstyled HTML. Fix: run apply-html-head-contract.mjs <css-path> index-v2.html --replace-head

[html-infrastructure] [MAIN-AGENT] index-v2.html missing <style id="theme-vars"> theme CSS variable block. Impact: all semantic token colors degrade to transparent/default values. Fix: run apply-html-head-contract.mjs <css-path> index-v2.html --replace-head

[html-infrastructure] [MAIN-AGENT] index-v2.html missing @theme inline Tailwind <-> CSS variable bridge block. Impact: bg-primary, text-foreground and similar classes cannot map to theme colors. Fix: run apply-html-head-contract.mjs <css-path> index-v2.html --replace-head

[html-infrastructure] [MAIN-AGENT] index-v2.html missing @layer base global base styles. Impact: body background color, font, table word-break and other base styles are lost. Fix: run apply-html-head-contract.mjs <css-path> index-v2.html --replace-head

[html-infrastructure] [MAIN-AGENT] index-v2.html missing <html class="light"> or <html class="dark"> theme mode selector. Impact: CSS variable selectors do not match; all theme colors stop working. Fix: run apply-html-head-contract.mjs <css-path> index-v2.html --replace-head

[html-infrastructure] [MAIN-AGENT] index.html missing <html class="light"> or <html class="dark"> theme mode selector. Impact: CSS variable selectors do not match; all theme colors stop working. Fix: run apply-html-head-contract.mjs <css-path> index.html --replace-head

pages.title: 首页 v3 · 全幅产品剧场版
pages.visualNorthStar: A dark product-theater homepage inspired by Linear/Cursor/Vercel: CENTERED full-bleed hero with product console bleeding to viewport edges (NO left-right split). Warm near-black canvas, warm paper text, single amber accent. Editorial section numbering 01-05. Full-width stacked sections with varying heights and compositions. 8-agent system as full-width horizontal flow + unequal bento. Core features as full-width bands (not 2x2 cards). 8-dim profile as deliberately unequal bento. Three roles as full-width tabs. Tech stack as terminal. Full-width pull quotes.
